description: This file defines an Android activity called SplitTouchView that demonstrates splitting touch events across multiple views. It sets up two ListViews with adapters, handles item click events, and displays Toast messages based on user interactions.

classes.name: SplitTouchView
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating touch event splitting across multiple ListViews.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity layout, initializes list views with adapters, and assigns click listeners.

methods.name: itemClickListener
methods.description: Handles list item clicks, shows a Toast with a response message.
